_help: Reference library. Each entry: id (short unique name used by questions), title, org, category, models, description, url, topics (topic ids from topics.json). Add a new entry by copying one block and changing it.

references.title: TM101I - Servicing Vertiv Thermal Management Equipment (course description, 2022)
references.description: Official description of the 3-day instructor-led Vertiv Academy course for thermal management technicians. Lists service approach, equipment types, preventive maintenance and troubleshooting as course subjects. Prerequisite listed: TM001O Introducing Thermal Dynamics for Thermal Management.

references.title: Vertiv Thermal Training Course Schedules
references.models: All thermal training courses (TM101I, TM202I and others)
references.description: Vertiv's thermal training schedule page. Older listings show TM202I as 'Vertiv Thermal Management Small Systems'. Contact Vertiv thermal training for current dates and syllabus.

references.title: Getting Started with Vertiv Liebert iCOM - Installer/User Guide (SL-31075)
references.description: General iCOM controller guide: display, menus, setpoints, alarms, unit-to-unit networking and control parameters. Menus and features vary by unit type and firmware version.

references.title: Liebert iCOM User Manual (legacy, Emerson era) - control, proportional band, deadband, compressor staging
references.org: Liebert / Emerson Network Power (hosted by ManualsLib)
references.models: Older iCOM-controlled Liebert DS, CW, Challenger, Deluxe units
references.description: Older iCOM manual explaining proportional band split into cooling and heating halves, optional deadband centered on setpoint, Proportional / PI / Intelligent control, compressor proportional bands, 4-step unloader staging and digital scroll operation. Third-party host; use the official Vertiv manual for your unit when available.

references.title: Liebert iCOM-S User Manual
references.description: Manual for the iCOM-S touchscreen supervisory system that monitors and coordinates multiple cooling units.

references.title: Liebert iCOM CMS Quick Installation Guide (SL-18830)
references.description: Quick installation guide for the iCOM CMS monitoring/control module used on small-room systems such as Mini-Mate2 and DataMate. The full iCOM CMS Installer/User Guide can be found through Vertiv support.

references.title: Vertiv Unit-to-Unit (U2U) Communication Setup Installer/User Guide (SL-70876)
references.models: iCOM-equipped units networked together (e.g. PDX, PCW, DS)
references.description: How multiple iCOM units are networked so they can share information, run teamwork modes and rotate standby units.

references.title: Liebert CRV with iCOM - User Manual
references.description: iCOM operation as applied to CRV row-based cooling: rack inlet sensors, setpoints and alarms.

references.title: Liebert DS Installer/User Guide, 35-105 kW, 50/60 Hz
references.description: Installation, operation, maintenance and troubleshooting for the Liebert DS, including compressor options, digital scroll unloading solenoids, head pressure control, humidifier, reheat and preventive maintenance. Very large PDF.

references.title: Liebert DSE 50-165 kW User Manual
references.models: Liebert DSE with EconoPhase pumped refrigerant economizer
references.description: DSE installation, operation and service, including digital scroll compressor unloading solenoid information and economizer operation.

references.title: Liebert EconoPhase Pumped Refrigerant Economizer (product page)
references.description: Explains the pumped refrigerant economizer used with Liebert DSE: when outdoor temperature is low enough, refrigerant pumps move heat to the condenser and compressor run time is reduced or eliminated, without outside air or water.

references.title: Liebert PDX and Liebert PCW Thermal Management System User Manual
references.models: Liebert PDX (DX) and Liebert PCW (chilled water)
references.description: User manual for the PDX direct-expansion and PCW chilled-water perimeter units, both controlled by iCOM.

references.title: Liebert PDX / Liebert PCW System Design Manual
references.description: Design catalog describing configurations, components and options of PDX and PCW units.

references.title: Liebert PDX Direct Expansion Floor-Mount Cooling Unit (product page)
references.description: Product overview of the PDX DX floor-mount unit family.

references.title: Liebert PCW Chilled Water Floor-Mount Cooling Unit (product page)
references.description: Product overview of the PCW chilled-water perimeter unit controlled by iCOM.

references.title: Liebert CRV In-Row Cooling System Datasheet (TM303)
references.description: Datasheet for the CRV row-based (in-row) precision cooling unit designed for high-density racks.

references.title: Liebert Mini-Mate2 2-3 Ton User Manual
references.description: Installation, piping, startup and maintenance for the ceiling-mounted Mini-Mate2. Separate guides exist for 1-1.5 ton and 5 ton units.

references.title: Liebert Mini-Mate2 1-1.5 Ton User Manual
references.description: Smaller-capacity Mini-Mate2 installer/user guide.

references.title: Liebert Mini-Mate Variable Capacity Installer/User Guide
references.description: Ceiling-mounted variable-capacity Mini-Mate. The guide notes Mini-Mate systems require POE (polyolester) oil.

references.title: Liebert Prop Fan Digital Condensing Unit User Manual
references.models: Liebert PFD condensing unit (used with Mini-Mate variable capacity)
references.description: Outdoor prop-fan condensing unit with digital scroll compressor; includes unloading solenoid information.

references.title: Liebert DataMate 1.5-3 Ton User Manual
references.description: Installation, preventive maintenance and troubleshooting for the DataMate small-room cooling unit.

references.title: Liebert Deluxe System/3 Operation & Maintenance Manual (discontinued product)
references.description: Legacy manual. Describes four-step systems that add cylinder unloaders on one head of each semi-hermetic compressor so compressors can run at reduced capacity under low load.

references.title: Vertiv CoolPhase Perimeter DS035-105 User Manual (SL-80164)
references.models: Vertiv CoolPhase Perimeter (newer low-GWP perimeter units)
references.description: Newer perimeter DX unit documentation, including digital scroll unloading solenoid section.

references.title: What does precision air conditioning mean now?
references.description: Vertiv article on precision cooling for IT spaces vs comfort cooling.

references.title: How Copeland Scroll Digital Works
references.description: Explains digital scroll capacity modulation: solenoid energized = unloaded (scrolls separate axially, no pumping); de-energized = loaded (full capacity); average capacity set by the loaded/unloaded time ratio.

references.title: Copeland Digital Compressor Controller - Application Engineering Bulletin
references.models: Copeland Scroll Digital and Discus Digital compressors
references.description: Manufacturer bulletin for the controller that sits between a digital compressor and the system controller and drives the unloading solenoid. Useful for understanding digital compressor control and protection; details are model-specific.

references.title: Axial, Radial and Digital Scrolls
references.description: Technician-friendly explanation of axial/radial compliance and digital scroll loading/unloading, including the unusual sound and cycling amp draw of a digital scroll.

references.title: Superheat and Subcooling Basics (podcast/article)
references.description: Recap of superheat, subcooling, sensible vs latent heat, metering devices and target vs measured values. Notes that for zeotropic blends, superheat uses dew point and subcooling uses bubble point.

references.title: AC Pressures, Subcooling and Superheat (video)
references.description: Video explaining how suction/discharge pressure, superheat and subcooling relate, including subcooling as an indicator of liquid 'stacked' in the condenser.

references.title: Solving Superheat
references.description: How to interpret superheat readings as diagnostic data.

references.title: Compressor Failure Diagnosis and Replacement Checklist
references.description: Step-by-step approach to verifying a compressor failure before condemning it: power, controls, capacitors, windings, pressures and root cause.

references.title: Tips for Server Room Conditioning
references.description: Field advice for server rooms: uptime is critical, comfort-cooling assumptions don't apply, airflow management matters.

references.title: Have Fun with CRAC (Computer Room A/C) - podcast
references.description: Technician discussion of computer-room air conditioning service: precision cooling, humidity control and common field issues.

references.title: Best practices for maintaining a data center CRAC unit
references.description: Preventive maintenance article: filters as the most important routine task, belt tension checks, redundancy so a unit can be taken out of service.

references.title: Control of Hazardous Energy (Lockout/Tagout)
references.description: OSHA's main lockout/tagout page and standard 29 CFR 1910.147: energy control programs, procedures, training, and lock/tag rules.

references.title: 29 CFR 1910.147 - The control of hazardous energy (regulation text)
references.description: Full regulation text for lockout/tagout. Includes the rule that each lock/tag is removed only by the employee who applied it (with a limited, documented exception).

references.title: 29 CFR 1910.333 - Selection and use of work practices (electrical)
references.description: Electrical safety-related work practices, including requiring a qualified person to use test equipment to verify circuit parts are de-energized before work.

references.title: OSHA Electrical Safety topic page
references.description: Overview of electrical hazards, standards and training resources.

references.title: NFPA 70E, Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace
references.description: Consensus standard for electrically safe work practices, PPE, arc flash and establishing an electrically safe work condition. Free read-only access is available from NFPA after sign-in.

references.title: Electrical Safety Foundation International (ESFI) - workplace safety resources
references.description: Free workplace electrical safety resources, including the 'test before you touch' message.

references.title: Section 608 Technician Certification
references.description: Official EPA page on 608 certification (Core, Type I, II, III, Universal). Technicians who open refrigerant circuits must be certified.

references.title: Stationary Refrigeration and Air Conditioning (Section 608 overview)
references.description: EPA rules on refrigerant handling, venting prohibition, leak repair and recovery.

references.title: The Professor: Digital Capacity Control for Compressors
references.description: Trade-magazine explanation of digital (pulse-width) capacity control.

references.title: ASHRAE TC 9.9 - Mission Critical Facilities, Data Centers, Technology Spaces
references.description: ASHRAE technical committee responsible for data center thermal guidelines (recommended/allowable inlet temperature and humidity ranges).

references.title: Vertiv Support - documents and downloads
references.description: Starting point to find the correct manual for a specific model and serial number.
